craft_notes: Sthāyin: śeṣavṛtti unit 76. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 9. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Flowers and the rest all standing there in that deep water should throw; said altar-sacrifice this in constant rite by Śambhu.
l4.sanskrit_cite: puṣpādi sarvaṃ tatsthaṃ tadagādhāmbhasi nikṣipet uktaḥ sthaṇḍilayāgo@yaṃ nityakarmaṇi śambhunā
